text:
sara: Heads-up — vendor A reported 60 units from batch 78 failed preflight QC at the EU depot. Need swap plan + insurance claim. Any AWB/return flow thoughts?

devon: Ugh. Vendor A's lead time for replacements is 6–8 weeks from APAC. Do we have a spare pool in eu-west to cover EU demand?

alex: We have ~12 live spares in NL and 8 reserved for infra tests. Not enough for a 60-unit hit.

maria-ops: @sara can you drop the serial list + photos here? Also need declared value for insurance. Depot broker asked for HS code reference.

sara: Posted serials in the ticket (linked). Declared value per unit = 76,500 USD. Insurance contact said max recovery ~90%. Broker flagged HS code; they want 6-digit classification. Our broker suggests 847170 for GPUs.

kai: Vendor A offered partial drop-ship from their APAC pool if we accept expedite surcharge. Quote: +18% on unit price, 3-day air for the first tranche.

devon: Cost vs outage — can we do cross-region borrowing (move capacity from us-east)? Impact on EU latency?

jamie: Borrowing from us-east will bump some EU tails — 95p latency could move from 190ms -> ~230ms for affected routes. Dedicated customers might notice.

maria-ops: Depot throughput: can process ~40 return packages/day. With 60 failing units inbound, that's ~1.5 days to clear inbound queue before vendor can stage replacements. RMA AWB placeholder: RT1234567890. Vendor asked for consolidated AWB + commercial invoice copy.

sara: Asked vendor to split shipment 30/30 to avoid depot backlog and requested DOA flag + repair estimate on paperwork. Need someone to run quick cost calc on expedite vs borrow.

alex: Quick back-of-envelope: expedite APAC air for 30 units = roughly +$1.2M (surcharge, freight, brokerage). Cross-region borrow cost (transfer + transient SLA risk) estimated potential revenue hit / risk ~ $200k. I lean toward borrowing to minimize cash outlay and SLA pain.

kai: Note: if vendor ships from APAC, customs duties + broker fees add ~2% and possible delays if HS is disputed. Need broker pre-clear to avoid hang-ups.

devon: I'll coordinate with infra to identify which hosts we can temporarily sacrify and for how long. @jamie can you draft a one-paragraph comms for affected Dedicated customers?

jamie: On it. TL;DR: brief outage-risk note + timeline. Will share for rapid review.

shipment-bot: AWB RT1234567890 status -> Arrived at NL depot 2339123510; inbound scan complete.

maria-ops: Vendor agreed to split 30 now / 30 after depot clears. They will provide RMA labels and pre-paid return. We need approval for expedite for tranche 1. Approver: @finance-ledger.

finance-ledger: Approve up to $600k for expedite now. Please attach final vendor quote + revised commercial invoice for sign-off.

sara: Thanks — attaching vendor quote and photos to ticket. Will update once broker confirms HS 6-digit classification. Reopen if customs flags anything.

(threads / attachments: serials.csv, photos.zip, vendor-quote-2339.pdf)
